arguments.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(s) tot, ROUND(SUM(s)/100.0/COUNT(*),4) aov, MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts ts, (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id) s FROM orders o WHERE o.channel='store' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2024-12-31 16:00:00' AND o.order_ts<'2025-06-30 16:00:00')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 tot, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) aov, MIN(o.order_ts), MAX(o.order_ts) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='store' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2024-12-31 16:00:00' AND o.order_ts<'2025-06-30 16:00:00'
